violations.text: The establishment does not have a written procedure for cleaning vomit and diarrhea. Inspector provided RIDOH guidance. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2026
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen and the front bar area were lacking paper towels. Staff provided during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2026

Drain plugs and plastic bags were observed in the hand-washing sink in the upstairs bar; a tray of oranges was observed on the handwashing sink in the dish room. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Oranges were moved during inspection; upstairs bar was not in operation at the time of this inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2026

Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the kitchen. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. Soap was provided during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (vegetable peeler) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Peeler was taken out of service to be cleaned and sanitized. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2026

Eggs are served raw or undercooked to the customer's request. A written consumer advisory (on the menu, table tent, or placard) is not provided to the consumer informing them of the significantly increased risk associated with certain vulnerable consumers eating such food in a raw or undercooked form. New Violation. Correct By: 11/26/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Per interview of staff, recently cooked onions were placed hot in the cold drawer in plastic containers greater than four inches deep; recently prepared guacamole was placed in the prep unit to chill. Staff brought to freezer to rapidly chill. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2026

The ice scoop is stored on an unclean surface (top of the ice machine) between uses; ice bucket was not stored inverted. During pauses in food preparation, utensils must be stored on a clean surface or in a clean, protected location. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2026

Utensils (bar vegetable peeler, spoons, and cutlery) in the bar and dish wash area are displayed with the lip surface up. Utensils are to be stored so that only the handles are touched by employees and consumers if consumer self-service is provided. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2026
A bar low boy was observed with an ambient temperature of 46 degrees F. All items requiring refrigeration were moved to other units. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2026
Staff were unaware of how to set-up the 3-bay sink. Inspector worked with staff to properly set-up 3-bay sink and test sanitizer solution. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2026

The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machines at the bars. Inspector provided during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2026

The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quaternary ammonium sanitizing solution for the 3-bay sink. Inspector provided during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2026
Several ceiling tiles were observed missing in the basement dry storage area. New Violation. Correct By: 11/26/2026
The kitchen area is lacking a hand-washing sink. Inspector observed water lines in place; sink to be installed. New Violation. Correct By: 10/15/2026
A leak was observed at the basin of the kitchen 3-bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 10/15/2026
